
LIST-TAGS
List all registered tags from spec/tags.json

USAGE
  fspec list-tags [options]

OPTIONS
  --category <category>
    Filter tags by category (e.g., "Phase Tags", "Component Tags")

EXAMPLES
  1. List all tags
  $ fspec list-tags
  Phase Tags:
  @critical - Phase 1 features
  @high - Phase 2 features

Component Tags:
  @cli - CLI commands
  @parser - Parser features

  2. List tags in specific category
  $ fspec list-tags --category="Phase Tags"
  @critical - Phase 1 features
@high - Phase 2 features

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec register-tag
  fspec validate-tags
  fspec tag-stats
